judge.rationale: The candidate only entered the red phase of TDD: it wrote a failing acceptance test (`src/orchestration/nonErrorRejection.acceptance.test.ts`), updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and committed `.lore/dod.md`, but never modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to actually wrap non-Error rejections and call `onError`. Consequently, the new test will fail because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`. Additionally, the candidate completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the tree.
